text:
alex_sales: Hey finance — quick one. BrightSpring (SMB) asking for a 40% off on an annual prepay for Dedicated SKU (12mo commit). Our SMB max discount is 25%. Quote becomes $72,000 vs list $120,000. They offered two customer referrals and a pilot integration. Need one-off override — can we approve?

 tia_finance: Can you share simple P&L impact numbers and whether they want invoice upfront or monthly billing? :eyes:

 alex_sales: They want upfront annual prepay. Quick numbers below:  
```
list price: $120,000
40% off -> $72,000
25% policy -> $90,000
delta vs policy = $18,000 concession
expected gross margin hit ~ $9k (approx, assuming 50% gross)
```

 omri_dealdesk: Prefer structuring as a limited-time promo credit vs permanent discount. If finance ok, we can offer a $18k one-time onboarding credit applied on invoice instead of changing list price. Less precedent risk. Also need CRO sign-off for >25% concessions.

 maria_revops: If we go with credit, rev rec: upfront payment but credit on invoice — we'll need amendment in billing system and deferred revenue schedule updated. Also need tax team note for credit handling.

 legal-bot: Standard requirements for customer concessions: add amendment with (1) explicit no-resell clause, (2) referral deliverables and timelines, (3) success criteria for pilot. Provide exact language and we'll fast-track review.

 tia_finance: Numbers look OK to review. Two gating items: 1) total ARR / lifetime value estimate showing concession < $25k net present impact, and 2) written referral commitments in SOW. If both met, finance can approve a one-off concession/credit.

 alex_sales: Got it. I'll upload the referral LOIs and LTV note by EOD. If legal gives template, I'll attach draft amendment.

 omri_dealdesk: I'll queue CRO sign-off request once docs are in. Suggest we approve credit path to avoid changing pricebook.

 maria_revops: FYI — if we approve credit, billing needs code: "ONEOFF_CREDIT_BS_2331" and revenue ops will set deferred schedule to match current policy. I'll prep ticket.

 approval-bot: Approval request logged: A-2331-01. Status: pending finance sign-off + docs. Expires in 30 days.

 tia_finance: Conditional approval: finance APPROVES a one-time $18,000 onboarding credit (equivalent to 40% off) provided: (a) signed amendment with referral milestones, (b) CRO ok, (c) RevOps ticket created for invoice code and deferred revenue. Post docs here and I'll mark approved. :white_check_mark:

 alex_sales: Thanks — will upload docs and tag everyone. Appreciated! :sparkles:
